message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "enforce_imaging_tool_usage_for_diagnosis", "description": "When a diagnostic task involves interpreting medical images (e.g., chest X-rays), the agent must use dedicated imaging analysis tools rather than hallucinating findings or assuming alternative modalities.", "applicable_conditions": "Any clinical reasoning task where visual evidence (radiology images) is provided or implied as necessary for differential diagnosis, and specific image analysis tools are available in the environment.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["differential_diagnosis"], "required_tools": ["chest_xray_classifier", "chest_xray_report_generator"], "risk_level": "high", "core_action": "If the task requires analyzing medical images to support a diagnosis: (1) Identify the available image analysis tools (e.g., `chest_xray_classifier`, `chest_xray_report_generator`); (2) Call these tools with the provided image data to obtain objective findings; (3) Use the tool outputs as the sole basis for radiological evidence. Do NOT fabricate findings, assume CT/MRI results when only X-ray is available, or skip tool usage."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
